  "title": "Angular.io website is not GDPR compliant",
  "body": "### Description

Hi,

I searched the issue tracker, for both open and closed issue, with keywords "GDPR" and "Google", but no issue seemed related.

When first loading the angular.io website, there is a small pop-in on the lower-left corner of the site, stating that 

> This site uses cookies from Google to deliver its services and to analyze traffic. 

When looking at the [source code](https://github.com/angular/angular/blob/master/aio/src/index.html), one can see that : 

- the websites asks the browser to connect to GA
- the website asks the browser to connect to doubleclick
- 2 GA scripts are instantiated
- angular.io uses google fonts

[GDPR article 7](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/TXT/HTML/?uri=CELEX:32016R0679&from=FR#d1e2001-1-1) states that the consent has to be collected _prior_ to any sharing of personal data.

A German court ruled in January 2022 that Google Fonts usage was effectively illegal in the EU, without collecting users' consent prior to downloading them : https://thehackernews.com/2022/01/german-court-rules-websites-embedding.html
The French CNIL (Internet regulator) also sentenced a website owner because of GA in February 2022 : https://www.cnil.fr/en/use-google-analytics-and-data-transfers-united-states-cnil-orders-website-manageroperator-comply

Possible workarounds are :
 - either switch to a self-hosted analytics tool, OR collect consent before enabling any connection to Google's infrastructure
 - locally host the fonts




### What is the affected URL?

https://angular.io/

### Please provide the steps to reproduce the issue

Connect to the page (possibly using a private window if you accepted cookies before).

### Please provide the expected behavior vs the actual behavior you encountered

Expected behaviour : a banner/pop-in is displayed, asking for consent prior to using GA, doubleclickn and Google Fonts; if consent is refused, none of those tools is used during the browsing session.

Actual behaviour : a pop-in tells the user his personal data has been shared with Google.

### Please provide a screenshot if possible

https://i.imgur.com/7bTG7uy.png

### Please provide the exception or error you saw

```true
N/A
```


### Is this a browser-specific issue? If so, please specify the device, browser, and version.

```true
No
```
